desc:
A Wix app redesign and dashboard refresh gives your app a cleaner, more trustworthy interface without changing its features or data. Ecom Swift LLC redesigns dashboard pages and site widgets with the Wix Design System and checks them on desktop and phone.

## What is a Wix app redesign?

A Wix app redesign is a rework of what site owners see: the dashboard pages where they set the app up and the widgets that appear on their site. It improves layouts, forms, empty states, error messages and settings panels. The app keeps the same features, the same stored data and the same owners. Only the interface changes.

## Why a tidy interface builds trust

Site owners compare your app, often unconsciously, with the Wix dashboard around it. If your pages use different spacing, odd buttons or unfamiliar patterns, the app feels foreign and unfinished. People hesitate to trust an app that looks unfinished with their business data.

Using the Wix Design System solves much of this. Buttons, tables, forms and modals look and behave like the rest of the dashboard, so owners already know how to use them. That familiarity lowers the effort of learning your app.

## How design changes affect results

Design shapes whether people finish setup, find a setting or understand an error. A cluttered page hides the one action the owner needs. An empty table with no guidance leaves them stuck. A widget panel that mixes unrelated options makes customizing a chore.

Better layouts tend to reduce support questions, help owners reach their first success and make upgrades feel considered. These effects depend on your app and audience, so we describe what we improve, not what you will earn.

## What a good interface refresh includes

- Page layouts built from Wix Design System components.
- Clear headings and a single main action on each page.
- Helpful empty states that explain what to do first.
- Error messages that say what went wrong and how to fix it.
- Forms with sensible grouping, labels and validation.
- A site widget restyled to look sharp on real pages.
- A widget settings panel in the editor, grouped by task.
- A setup guide for new owners.
- A responsive check, so widgets work on a phone.
- An accessibility pass covering keyboard use, labels and contrast.

## How we redesign it

We review each page and widget, noting what confuses or crowds the owner. We show you the plan in plain terms, then rebuild the screens in code in your repository. Your features, data and behavior stay as they are, which means owners keep their settings after the update.

The Basic package refreshes a few dashboard pages and delivers before and after screenshots. Standard widens the scope to more pages, restyles one widget, adds a setup guide and checks the widget at different sizes. Premium covers a full refresh with a reorganized settings panel, an accessibility pass and editable Figma designs. We can also create designs before building, if you want to approve them first.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us which pages owners use most.
- Share complaints or support tickets about confusing screens.
- Keep the same names for features so owners recognize them.
- Review the screenshots before the update goes live.

**Avoid:**
- Redesigning every page at once with no priorities.
- Adding custom styling where a Wix component already exists.
- Moving settings to places owners will not find.
- Treating a redesign as a way to add new features. Those are a separate job.

## Who this is for

An app owner whose product works well but looks dated beside newer apps. A developer who built the logic and wants help with the interface. A team preparing a relaunch who wants the dashboard to match the new listing.

## What we need from you

Repository access and collaborator access to your Dev Center, by invitation. We never need your password. Please share your brand colors, logo and any screens you already know are problems. If you have Figma files, send them and we will work from those.
